newsitem.title: JAMAICA: CRICKET-ROSE TAKES FOUR WICKETS AS INDIA COLLAPSE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ROSE TAKES FOUR WICKETS AS INDIA COLLAPSE.

text.p: West Indies paceman Franklyn Rose, making his test debut, took four wickets as India collapsed before lunch on the third day of the first test at Sabina Park on Saturday.
India, resuming at a healthy 108 for one, were 155 for five at lunch in reply to the West Indies first innings total of 427 all out.

Rose, who had bowled six overs without success on Friday, claimed the wickets of Vangipurappu Laxman (64), Rahul Dravid (43), captain Sachin Tendulkar (seven) and Mohammad Azharuddin (five) in a devastating seven-over spell.
Saurav Ganguly was unbeaten on nine and Nayan Mongia was one not out at the interval.
